## Graphic Standards Manual

Week 1. Establish the graphic system used to communicate all later work.

- [Class 01]({{ site.baseurl }}/modules/classes/class-01/) — Week 1 — Aug 25: Begin the Graphic Standards Manual, test a sample sheet and organize your files.

<a id="b02"></a>

## Constructive Solid Geometry

Weeks 2–3. Build editable solids with transformations and Boolean operations.

- [Class 02 · Transformations and Booleans]({{ site.baseurl }}/modules/classes/class-02/) — Week 2 — Sep 1: Move, rotate and scale procedurally. Compare solid Boolean operators and begin the massing study.
- [Class 03 · 3D printing]({{ site.baseurl }}/modules/classes/class-03/) — Week 3 — Sep 8: Refine the CSG process sheet and instructions. Introduce P2b: prepare the CSG object for 3D printing, including units, orientation and slicing.

<a id="b03"></a>

## Descriptive Geometry

Weeks 4–5. Describe geometry through points, lines, edges and faces, then build a parametric solid.

- [Class 04 · Point to solid]({{ site.baseurl }}/modules/classes/class-04/) — Week 4 — Sep 15: Point → Line → Edge → Face → Solid → Boolean. Build the parametric pyramid and reconnect to the CSG project.
- [Class 05 · Your module, material and lighting]({{ site.baseurl }}/modules/classes/class-05/) — Week 5 — Sep 22: Build your own module from points and faces, test its parameter ranges, then render it with one material and a deliberate lighting setup for the P3a sheet.

<a id="b04"></a>

## Arrays

Weeks 6–10. Introduce 1D/2D/3D arrays, then use supported practice and critique to complete the module, array comparisons and manual by midterm. Other array families are optional later practice; a recording is not yet posted.

- [Class 06 · Arrays introduction; CSG sheet]({{ site.baseurl }}/modules/classes/class-06/) — Week 6 — Sep 29: Submit 2.1 by 11:59 PM. Introduce 1D/2D/3D arrays; check the CSG print file before queueing.
- Class 07 · Supported practice during studio reviews — *not yet released* — Week 7 — Oct 6: No graded submission. Optional help with module geometry, three-point lighting and small array tests.
- Class 08 · CSG print; module and material review — *not yet released* — Week 8 — Oct 13: Hand in 2.2 in class, with digital documentation by 11:59 PM. Review authored module materials, ground planes and key/fill/rim lighting.
- Class 09 · Module deadline; array comparisons — *not yet released* — Week 9 — Oct 20: Submit 3.1. Review 1D/2D/3D comparisons, conditional selection and library or student-authored materials for 3.2.
- Class 10 · Manual, arrays and cumulative midterm — *not yet released* — Week 10 — Oct 27: Submit the manual and 3.2. Review the accumulated result of the first five submissions; regular class, no separate midterm assignment.

<a id="b05"></a>

## Attractor-driven façade

Week 11. Use distance fields from points and curves to control geometric variation.

- Class 11 · Panel parameter driven by an attractor — *not yet released* — Week 11 — Nov 3: Introduce 3.3: measure and remap a field to one geometric panel parameter; compose a façade elevation and isometric.

<a id="b06"></a>

## Site analysis and SDF exploration

Weeks 12–13. Read spatial samples, convert them into volumes and use fields to control form.

- Class 12 · Attractor site analysis; façade check — *not yet released* — Week 12 — Nov 10: Introduce 4.1: document a site, map three analytical layers and state a spatial intention. Check 3.3 field-to-panel logic.
- Class 13 · Façade deadline; abstract SDF project — *not yet released* — Week 13 — Nov 17: Submit 3.3. Introduce 4.2 from the site intention; compare fields and coordinate elevation, isometric and abstract floor plan. Check 4.1 layers.

<a id="b07"></a>

## Discretizing Geometry

Week 14. Use contours and sections to translate a volumetric design into parts for fabrication.

- Class 14 · Site deadline; volume selection and discretization — *not yet released* — Week 14 — Nov 24: Submit 4.1. Select the SDF volume at an ungraded check; introduce 4.3 and 4.4: slicing, registration and integrated laser-cut/printed parts. Check a booklet spread.

<a id="b08"></a>

## Mixed-media model and final documentation

Week 15. Assemble and document one model combining laser-cut and 3D-printed parts, revise the project and prepare the final booklet.

- Class 15 · Connection tests, production and documentation — *not yet released* — Week 15 — Dec 1: No graded submission during studio reviews. Use ungraded support to check connections, part files, fabrication progress and final documentation.
